# Saved views

<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-START -->
<!-- A short orientation for this page; task guidance belongs under Use. Kept across regeneration. -->
`show_on_dashboard` and `show_in_sidebar` are `null` when Paperless omits them,
as payload version 10 does. The values are unknown, not false.
<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-END -->

## `list_saved_views`

**List Saved Views.** Read-only. Idempotent. Reaches outside the server.

List saved views, the named document filters users keep in Paperless; returns one page.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | `integer` | `1` | Page number, starting at 1. |
| `page_size` | `integer` | `25` | Results per page, up to 100. |

**Returns**

`object`

## `get_saved_view`

**Get Saved View.** Read-only. Idempotent. Reaches outside the server.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_id` | `integer` | required |  |
